ev-remove.intro.say: This removes Evalation from this machine.

ev-remove.unreachable.say: Evalation couldn't be reached, so nothing was changed. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.clock.say: This machine's clock is wrong, so nothing was removed. Set it to the right time, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.damaged.say: This machine's Evalation sign-in is damaged, so it can't be signed out from here.

ev-remove.not-signed-in.say: This machine isn't signed in to Evalation.

ev-remove.sign-out.say: This signs this machine out of Evalation and deletes its keys here. Your account and pack credits stay.

ev-remove.folder.say: It also deletes Evalation's folder on this machine, with your saved results, your pack choice and any question sets saved only here. Sets on your account stay.

ev-remove.folder-local.say: It deletes Evalation's folder on this machine, with your saved results, your pack choice and any question sets saved here.

ev-remove.sets-stay-local.say: Your account can't be reached from this machine, so the question sets saved here can't be moved to it.

ev-remove.nothing-saved.say: Evalation has saved nothing on this machine.

ev-remove.only-sign-in.say: Evalation holds only this machine's damaged sign-in and its keys here. Removing deletes them.

ev-remove.nothing-else.say: Evalation has nothing else on this machine.

ev-remove.old-reports.say: Evalation's folder also holds reports an older version saved there: <reports>. Removing Evalation deletes them, and reports in your Documents folder stay.

ev-remove.report.say: the <names> from the check of <repository> on <date>

options.label: Remove it
options.description: Signs this machine out and deletes Evalation's folder and keys here.

options.label: Remove it
options.description: Deletes what Evalation saved on this machine.

ev-remove.keep-sets.ask: Keep <sets> on your account before removing?

options.label: Keep on my account
options.description: You can use them on your other computers.

ev-remove.keep-set.ask: Keep <sets> on your account before removing?

options.label: Keep on my account
options.description: You can use it on your other computers.

ev-remove.conversations.say: Claude Code keeps <count> other conversations where you ran an Evalation command, including what Evalation found in your code. They're from these project folders: <places>. Deleting them can't be undone, and other conversations and your project files stay as they are.

ev-remove.conversation.say: Claude Code keeps one other conversation where you ran an Evalation command, including what Evalation found in your code. It's from the project folder <folder>, on <from>. Deleting it can't be undone, and other conversations and your project files stay as they are.

ev-remove.open-one.say: One of them is open in another Claude Code window, so it's kept. To delete it too, close that window first.

ev-remove.open-many.say: <count> of them are open in other Claude Code windows, so they're kept. To delete those too, close those windows first.

ev-remove.recent-one.say: One of them changed in the last hour, so it's kept in case it's still open.

ev-remove.recent-many.say: <count> of them changed in the last hour, so they're kept in case they're still open.

ev-remove.clear.ask: Also delete the Claude Code conversations that used Evalation?

options.label: Delete them
options.description: Deletes them, except any still open.

ev-remove.set-fails.ask: The question set "<set>" needs fixing with /ev-questions before it can go on your account. What should happen to it?

options.label: Delete it with the rest
options.description: Deletes the set and carries on removing.

options.label: Stop so I can fix it

ev-remove.fix-set.say: Nothing was removed. Run /ev-remove again once the set is fixed.

ev-remove.set-not-kept.say: The question set "<set>" couldn't be saved to your account, so nothing was removed. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.run-unreachable.say: Evalation couldn't be reached, so nothing was removed. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-remove again.

ev-remove.run-refused.say: Evalation wouldn't sign this machine out, so nothing was removed. Email support@evalation.ai for help.

ev-remove.signed-out.say: This machine is signed out of Evalation.

ev-remove.already-out.say: This machine was already signed out of Evalation.

ev-remove.not-revoked.say: Evalation couldn't sign this machine out. Email support@evalation.ai to have its sign-in switched off.

ev-remove.sets-kept.say: The question sets <sets> are on your account.

ev-remove.folder-deleted.say: Evalation's folder on this machine is deleted.

ev-remove.folder-left.say: Some of Evalation's files on this machine couldn't be deleted. Run /ev-remove again to finish.

ev-remove.key-left.say: One key is still in this machine's password store: <keys>. Delete it by hand, such as in Keychain Access on a Mac.

ev-remove.keys-left.say: <count> keys are still in this machine's password store: <keys>. Delete them by hand, such as in Keychain Access on a Mac.

ev-remove.keys-unread.say: Evalation couldn't tell which keys it kept on this machine, so some may still be in its password store. Delete them by hand, such as in Keychain Access on a Mac. They're under the service evalation-plugin, or evalation on older setups, with an account ending in installation-key, receiving-key or receiving-key-previous. If this machine also runs the Evalation engine, leave the engine's entries.

ev-remove.kept-this.say: This conversation is still open, so it was kept.

ev-remove.kept-two.say: This conversation and one other still open were kept.

ev-remove.kept-more.say: This conversation and <count> others still open were kept.

ev-remove.recent-this.say: This conversation was kept, since Evalation can't tell whether it's still open.

ev-remove.recent-more.say: <count> conversations that changed in the last hour were kept, this one among them, since Evalation can't tell which are still open.

ev-remove.uninstall.say: To finish, uninstall the plugin by running this in Claude Code:

ev-remove.other.say: That isn't one of the choices, so nothing was removed.
